## Next.js Online Code Compiler Project

This project is an online code compiler similar to CodeChef that supports C, C++, Python, Java, and JavaScript.

### Project Status
- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md in .github directory
- [x] Scaffold Next.js project with TypeScript
- [x] Create code editor component
- [x] Create API routes for code execution
- [x] Install dependencies and compile project
- [x] Create and run development task

### Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- TypeScript
- React
- Code editor with syntax highlighting
- API routes for code execution

### Supported Languages
- C
- C++
- Python
- Java
- JavaScript
